_comment: Field definitions — ADR-177. One home per field: what a field IS.
A module manifest says WHICH fields it uses and whether each is required
THERE, and never re-declares any of this. `required` is a property of
(module, field) and so lives in the manifest, not here.
`channel` is DECLARED, never derived from the directory a module sits in
(ADR-177 addendum 2026-09-28). `size` names a rendering context, not a
point on a length scale — a hero headline is the largest type and
`type: image` (ADR-197; ADR-177 addendum 2026-10-15): a library image,
written asset:<id>, or an https address. `alt` names the field holding its
alt text, which inherits the library image's alt when left empty.
`label` is what a form calls the field, written once here (ADR-177 addendum
2026-10-04, task-271): never built from concept and size, never declared in a
manifest. The size is named only where it tells two fields of one concept
apart ('Hero headline' / 'Headline'). `note` is guidance for a person or an AI;
the six notes that were old manifest labels became the labels.

headline_hero.label: Hero headline
headline_hero.note: The h1. Largest type in the email and usually over a background image, so it must be SHORT — shorter than headline_medium.

section_heading.label: Heading above this module
section_heading.note: Optional. Shown above the module, and only when the module itself is shown.

footer_note.label: Note for this email
footer_note.note: Optional. Shown at the top of the footer, in this email only.
